observations.body: Peter proclaims Jesus’ ministry, death, resurrection, witness, and forgiveness; while he speaks, the Holy Spirit falls, Jewish believers hear languages and praise, and Peter orders baptism.
observations.label: The Spirit falls on Gentile hearers before water baptism

observations.body: The passage presents Hearing and Spirit before water baptism as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Hearing and Spirit before water baptism

observations.body: The passage places Languages and magnifying God beside Hearing and Spirit before water baptism.
observations.label: Languages and magnifying God

payload.posture: Read Acts 10:34–48 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states peter proclaims Jesus’ ministry, death, resurrection, witness, and forgiveness; while he speaks, the Holy Spirit falls, Jewish believers hear languages and praise, and Peter orders baptism. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
payload.title: The Spirit falls on Gentile hearers before water baptism
